combination_slots.rule: Only combine nonconflicting one-factor changes that individually improve the same parent's strict/contact-valid screen rank.

geometry.selection: Rank strict/contact-valid geometry screens lexicographically; select up to two distinct parents. Resolve adaptive slots once and save decisions before running them.

controllers.conditional_arm_feedback: Only replace a listed candidate if arm motion/tracking error precedes degradation; otherwise NOT RUN.
controllers.selection: Use the best strict/contact-valid geometry and one contrasting informative parent; no combination of new laws in a first trial.

promotion.mandatory_rung10: 30 then 60 then first 120 if preceding strict duration passes, regardless of early convergence score
promotion.baseline_120: One enhanced diagnostic reproduction; archived nominal 60 s supplies its preceding duration. Counts against first_120s.
promotion.remaining_120_selection: After mandatory/baseline attempts, rank eligible 60 s candidates across families; prefer evidence from distinct mechanisms. Maximum six first attempts overall.
promotion.finalists: Only single-run 120 s strict/contact/late-motion passes; freeze identity before repeat/fine.

contact_criteria.control_samples: Every scored sample must retain thumb-specific opposition and accepted thumb-below/all-fingers-above ordering

events.window_rule: HOLD entry and first scored loss/crossing per signal; all transitions, durations and extrema retained

load_distribution_flag: Per-hand signed Fz below 50% of matched reference 20-30 s mean; never claim stronger grasp capacity from unloading
optional_boundary_branch: Use only if coupled interventions remain uninterpretable; at most six explicitly assisted diagnostic cases, never capacity qualification.
